# Keep predefined menu action commands version scoped without restricting user commands

MenuActionCommand defines _execute_browser_action for Manifest Version 2 and _execute_action for Version 3, with compose and message-display action commands in both. The menu command property still accepts either a string or the named type. Keep that union: the documentation type does not ban user-defined command strings.

Scope: mail/components/extensions.
